text: Good evening, I'm a foster carer and I've got a little boy with me who's 19 months. He's had a temperature since yesterday and I took it about twenty minutes ago and it was 38.9. I might be reading too much into this, but I've noticed he doesn't seem to want to bend his head forward. I tried getting him to look down at his tummy, I pointed at his belly button and tickled it, which normally gets him looking straight down, and he just wouldn't, or couldn't, I'm honestly not sure which. I tried again a bit later with a toy held low and the same thing happened. I don't think I'm imagining it but I could be wrong, he's not my own so I'm still learning what's usual for him. I've given him his paracetamol at the right dose. I'd rather check with you than leave it, if that's alright.
